# WT-3 Wind Turbine Service Manual

This manual covers scheduled maintenance of the WT-3 turbine. Always follow lock-out procedures before work. Technicians must hold a valid GWO certificate and work in pairs at height.

## 1. Safety and access

Before climbing, stop the rotor using the service brake and engage the rotor lock pin. Wind speed at hub height must be below 12 m/s for nacelle access and below 8 m/s for hub entry. Use the fall-arrest rail on the ladder and keep three points of contact at all times. The emergency descent device is stored in the yellow cabinet next to the top platform.

## 2. Gearbox

The gearbox is a three-stage planetary design with a ratio of 1:97. Check the oil level weekly through the sight glass on the left side of the housing. The oil must be changed every 18 months or 20,000 operating hours, whichever comes first. Use ISO VG 320 synthetic gear oil; the gearbox holds 210 litres. Replace the inline oil filter (part GX-18) at every oil change. Abnormal noise or a temperature above 80 °C requires a vibration analysis before restart.

### 2.1 Gearbox torque values

| Fastener | Torque |
|---|---|
| Torque arm bolts M36 | 2,850 Nm |
| Housing cover M16 | 210 Nm |
| Oil drain plug | 95 Nm |
| Sensor bracket M8 | 25 Nm |

## 3. Main bearing

The main bearing is a double-row spherical roller bearing. Regrease it every 6 months with 400 g of lithium-complex grease (NLGI 2) through the four nipples on the bearing housing. Rotate the rotor slowly by hand during greasing so the grease spreads evenly. Collect old grease from the drain trays and dispose of it as hazardous waste.

## 4. Yaw system

The yaw system uses eight hydraulic brake calipers and four yaw drives. Inspect the yaw brake pads every 12 months and replace them when the friction lining is thinner than 3 mm. The yaw ring gear is lubricated automatically; refill the lubrication pump reservoir (2 kg cartridge) during each annual service.

## 5. Blades

Inspect the blades visually from the ground every 3 months using binoculars or a drone. Leading-edge erosion deeper than 1 mm must be repaired with polyurethane leading-edge protection tape. Lightning receptors at each blade tip must show a resistance below 50 milliohm when tested with the micro-ohmmeter.

## 6. Electrical

Test the converter cooling fans monthly. The main transformer oil sample is taken once a year and sent for dissolved gas analysis. Thermographic inspection of all power cable terminations is mandatory every 12 months; terminations warmer than 15 K above the reference must be re-torqued.
